newsitem.title: USA: US House may not do D.C. bill before recess-Armey.
newsitem.headline: US House may not do D.C. bill before recess-Armey.

text.p: The U.S. House of Representatives may not complete work on the appropriations bill for District of Columbia before its August recess, House Majority Leader Richard Armey said Tuesday.

"I do share with the chairmen of the committees a confidence that we will complete all these bills with the possible exception of the D.C. appropriations bill before the August recess," the Texas Republican said, referring to various bills being considered by committees this week.
"I do not expect any change in the schedule related to the August recess," he added.
